svg.text: Real cylinder, 25 views: uncalibrated vs. calibrated camera
Uncalibrated, the mesh's size was off by 32% on average; calibrated, by 5%: 7x the error without calibration.
Observed surfaces (what the camera measured). Same captures, alignment and fusion; only the camera mount differs (21mm / 2.2deg apart). Uncalibrated is the mount entered by hand in the Viam app.
